findings.desc: quality-regression: packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts:511 makes all direct finding/pass calls fail whenever LATTICE_MANAGED_HOST_RUN_ID is inherited; packages/main/src/tasks/provider-codex-smoke.ts:325 then runs agent-liveness-suite children with that inherited environment. In this managed reviewer run, provider-codex-smoke fails in agent-dispatch-registry-smoke before its intended assertions. The same nested suite also inherits LATTICE_AGENT, producing a different identity-conflict failure when only the run id is removed. Sanitize managed reviewer/role environment variables for fixture children (as the new managed aggregate suite does), or avoid invoking the nested suite under those variables.

quality-regression: packages/main/src/core/managed-review-evidence.ts:115 rejects a ReviewRun without assembledPrompt when the role template changed, instead of preserving the exact historical prompt or providing a compatible migration path. After clearing the inherited managed-review variables, provider-codex-smoke still fails through review-pass-discard-smoke with "legacy reviewer prompt reconstruction drift for lattice-review-docs" because this story changes that template. This breaks the required provider smoke and prevents managed dispatch for otherwise signed legacy runs.
